basis: JR East 2017 plaza opening plan: white granite, two lawns around 1200 m2, paired zelkova rows, three-lamp poles.
JSCE 2020 design-award as-built aerial and street photographs: traffic-square pools, slim glass shelters, granite seats.
Katabami planting photographs and Teikin installed lawn ropes and furniture.
limits: Photo-informed proportions fitted to inherited station coordinates; not a georeferenced survey.
The central white axis is centred on X=0; two lawns are each 15 x 40 m.
Transport bay counts, furniture dimensions and landscape species outside the central rows are approximations.
Existing M7/M8 positions and below-ground passages remain model approximations; their real openings are kept clear.
Cooling paving is shown dry. No contemporary temporary event furniture is asserted.
